# Project Configuration
# Generated by devpilot install.sh — edit with /dp-setup wizard

## Project Identity

project_name: "my-project"
project_type: fullstack          # frontend | backend | fullstack | db | integration | all
ticket_prefix: "KEY"             # e.g. MSK, APP, PRJ — matches Jira project key (lowercase in branches)
base_branch: develop             # branch PRs target & DEV deploys from. Use `develop` for the
                                  # DEV→SIT→UAT→PRD pipeline; `main` only for trunk-based projects.

## Issue Tracker
# local  — no external service; tasks logged to docs/tasks/<KEY>.md  (zero setup — default)
# github — GitHub Issues via the gh CLI (falls back to local if gh is unavailable)
# jira   — Jira Cloud (set credentials in .devpilot/config.sh)

tracker:
  type: local                    # local | github | jira

## Merge Policy
# auto    — devpilot squash-merges the PR into base_branch automatically (default)
# pr-only — devpilot opens the PR and stops; a human merges it

merge_policy: auto               # auto | pr-only

## Docs Language
# Human language for BA requirements, QA, and review docs. Code, identifiers,
# commit messages, and branch names stay in English regardless.

language: en                     # en | ar | fr | es | de | …

## Tech Stack

stack:
  frontend: angular              # angular | none
  backend: dotnet                # dotnet | none
  database: sqlserver            # sqlserver | none
  integration: none              # rabbitmq | kafka | azure-servicebus | none

## Active Agents
# The install wizard enables only agents relevant to your stack.
# Set enabled: false to disable an agent without removing it.

agents:
  ba:           { enabled: true }
  team_lead:    { enabled: true }
  frontend:     { enabled: true }   # set false if stack.frontend = none
  backend:      { enabled: true }   # set false if stack.backend = none
  db:           { enabled: true }   # set false if stack.database = none
  integration:  { enabled: false }  # set false if stack.integration = none
  qa:           { enabled: true }

## Claude Models — task-balanced
#
# DevPilot runs on Claude only. Each agent has a role model (models.*), and the
# orchestrator picks a tier PER TASK by complexity (scripts/resolve-model.sh):
#   power    → architectural / cross-cutting / high-risk / large changes
#   standard → normal feature & bug implementation (the default)
#   lite     → simple / mechanical / small changes
#
# Change with /dp-setup models <auto|balanced|save>  or  one model for everyone:
#   bash scripts/model-profiles.sh single <model-id>

model_policy:
  coding_profile: auto           # auto (Opus for hard work) | balanced (no Opus) | save (Haiku-first) | single
  model_mode: recommended        # recommended (profile tiers) | single (one model) | per-team (edit models.*, then sync-agents)

coding_models:
  claude:
    power:    "claude-opus-5-5"
    standard: "claude-sonnet-5"
    lite:     "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001"

## Agent role models — synced into .claude/agents/*.md frontmatter by
## scripts/model-profiles.sh (apply | single | sync-agents).

models:
  ba:
    tier1: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

  team_lead:
    tier1: claude-sonnet-5

  qa:
    tier1: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

  frontend_dev:
    tier1: claude-sonnet-5

  backend_dev:
    tier1: claude-sonnet-5

## Usage limits
# When a run hits a Claude usage limit it checkpoints to docs/tasks/<KEY>-checkpoint.json
# and stops cleanly; `/dp-deliver resume` continues from the exact phase once the limit resets.
